_voted_data_note: HaAchdut was launched on 2026-08-11 by Gilad Erdan (former UN/US ambassador and Likud minister) with Yuli Edelstein second on the list. Voted positions are two-tiered: where Edelstein has a recorded 25th-Knesset vote of his own it is used; on the remaining questions the aggregated Likud faction record is shown. Erdan was not a 25th-Knesset MK (he served as ambassador). The party was founded in opposition to the July 2026 conscription law, so its stated position on the draft diverges sharply from the voting record it inherits.
